relations.subject: John George Woodroffe
relations.evidence: Young John was educated at Woburn Park School and the University College, Oxford, where he took second classes in jurisprudence and the Bachelor of Civil Law examinations.

relations.subject: John George Woodroffe
relations.evidence: He was soon made a Fellow of the Calcutta University and appointed Tagore Law Professor.

relations.subject: John George Woodroffe
relations.evidence: He collaborated with Ameer Ali in a widely used textbook, Civil Procedure in British India.

relations.subject: John George Woodroffe
relations.evidence: After retiring to England he served as Reader in Indian Law to the University of Oxford.

relations.subject: John George Woodroffe
relations.evidence: he relied very heavily for his work on a group of mentors, especially his close friend A.B. Ghose.
